anos_1s: Crop years with mapping coverage in the first-semester (1S) campaign.
anos_2s: Crop years with mapping coverage in the second-semester (2S) campaign.
year_format: Agricultural years as "YYYY-YYYY" pairs, comma-separated per cell.
long_aggregates: Tokens spanning more than one harvest year (e.g. "2000-2014", "2000-2015") are multi-year rollups, not single agricultural years; rows carrying them are flagged is_long_aggregate.
calendar_months: Calendar `months` arrays run October→September (CONAB bulletin order), one code per month (P/H/PH/"").
area_shares: Calendar rows carry `areaSharePct` = UF share (%) of the crop national area from CONAB safra 2024/25 closed bulletin per-UF sheets (conab_safra_2024_25.xlsx, Jul/2025; full matrix in conab_area_shares.json). Repo PAM is national-only and cannot supply UF splits — unmapped crops carry NO areaSharePct (honest `mode: uf` fallback).
